description: This file defines post-processing middleware for HTML content in a Next.js server environment, including font and image optimization functionalities.

classes.name: FontOptimizerMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for optimizing font loading by inlining font definitions and managing preconnect links.

classes.name: ImageOptimizerMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for preloading images based on eligibility criteria to improve page load performance.

methods.name: registerPostProcessor
methods.description: Registers a middleware into the global registry with optional conditions.

methods.name: processHTML
methods.description: Main function that applies registered middleware to process and transform HTML content.

methods.name: inspect
methods.description: Method in middleware classes to analyze DOM and extract relevant data (e.g., font links, images).

methods.name: mutate
methods.description: Method in middleware classes to modify HTML markup based on inspection results.
